PDF.js 6.5.438 (Mozilla), Apache-2.0.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.5.438.tgz
The files are the package's `build/pdf.min.mjs` and `build/pdf.worker.min.mjs`, renamed to `pdf.js` and `pdf.worker.js` for consistent JavaScript MIME types on static hosts. They remain ES modules.
The license is included in this directory. Used only to render the original MILE teaser PDF in the homepage.
